text:
olivia: quick heads-up  we need a short operable play for SI co-sell when hardware partners (eg. Aurora Systems) and marketplace flows are involved. recent joint announce prep exposed confusion about who owns pre-sales and joint comms.

vikram: +1. propose a deterministic priority list: 1) SI holds ownership when they provide contractual evidence (SOW/PO/invoice/customer cc); 2) marketplace purchase routes to SI if checkout contains partner_id or sku prefix partner_; 3) HW partner deals where Aurora is reseller/OEM -> escalate to partnerships with reseller_chain tag; 4) Redwood-originated inbound -> Redwood owns; 5) simultaneous outreach within 10 days -> joint.

tara: add paid pilot precedence: if SI or HW partner underwrites pilot (PO uploaded) they get priority even if RW-originated. require claim asserted within 7 days of lead ingestion or it expires.

matt: ops reality: hardware OEMs often route orders to distributers and metadata changes. propose two heuristics: marketplace sku prefix OR order_note contains partner_handle -> auto-flag; else ops queue for manual assign. will file ticket for regex heuristics.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-11011: "marketplace + hw-partner attribution heuristics" assigned to matt, due 2024-07-22.

vikram: small SFDC intake snippet we can use for automation:
```
claim_source: [redwood|si|marketplace|hw_partner]
claim_proof_url: string
claim_proof_type: [sow|po|invoice|email|portal_action]
claim_window_days: 7
primary_owner: [redwood|si|joint|partner]
escalation_contact: partnerships@redwood.com
reseller_chain: string|null
```

olivia: love it, but keep the intake minimal for SEs. maybe collapse claim_proof_type and proof_url into one field proof_url and require type inference. also add a 4-bullet handoff checklist to reduce buyer ping-pong: 1) one-liner deal summary, 2) named POCs (buyer + SI + RW), 3) procurement path (marketplace/PO/reseller), 4) next step owner and ETA.

tara: can we also add a short public-facing line for joint announcements: "Primary contact for product/technical questions: <entity>; Primary contact for commercial/procurement questions: <entity>". keeps press and marketing aligned.

vikram: dispute flow: 2 business day triage, if unresolved by day 3 lock to earliest documented outreach and notify both parties + buyer. for global accounts/reseller chains escalate to partnerships lead (assign @olivia).

partner-bot: Created task PRT-5500: "joint-announcement contact template" assigned to tara, due 2024-07-19.

matt: action items: I'll add OPS-11011 details and prototype the regex + ops queue display showing earliest outreach timestamp. will link ticket here.

tara: I'll draft the announcement contact template and the short SE-facing one-pager.

vikram: I'll implement SFDC validation rules and wire the intake field mapping.

olivia: perfect. target publish to partner portal by Friday so SEs and marketing have consistent language. if anyone has a short anonymized example of a hardware reseller chain that caused trouble, drop it here for the playbook. :thumbsup:
